adversarialCases.contractRef: G006 objective: conflicts and overbook audit
adversarialCases.scenario: A group fixed lesson and a solo lesson occupy the same Tuesday 10:00 slot.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The engine records an overbook conflict and the decision helper blocks adding another student to that slot.

adversarialCases.scenario: Two members of the same group receive different attendance statuses for the same shared lesson.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: One shared-slot log stores attendanceByMember for each member and keeps the primary payer metadata.

adversarialCases.scenario: A group consult with two members and a primary payer is normalized as a student conversion payload.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The mapped student remains a group shared slot with both members and the original primary payer.

adversarialCases.scenario: A canceled fixed slot and an active makeup slot share the same time.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The canceled slot remains visible as metadata but is excluded from conflict audit.

adversarialCases.scenario: A flex one-off override is marked as makeup with a source lesson date.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The engine preserves overrideType='makeup' and makeupOf metadata on the slot.
